ambiguities.text: ENRRequest senders should have recently exchanged ping packets - 'recently' is not precisely defined
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume 'recently' means within a configurable timeout window (e.g., 12 hours). Implementations should define this threshold explicitly.

ambiguities.text: The specification does not define behavior when enr-seq field is missing in legacy ping/pong packets
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume missing enr-seq field should be treated as sequence 0, indicating a node not supporting EIP-868.

implicit_assumptions.description: Nodes trust that the secp256k1 signature on ENR records cannot be forged
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Attackers could forge ENR records to impersonate other nodes or inject malicious node information

implicit_assumptions.description: Attackers cannot spoof source IP addresses to bypass ping exchange requirement
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Amplification attacks become possible if attacker can spoof IPs to appear as previously pinged peers

implicit_assumptions.description: Nodes have reliable access to accurate system time for expiration checking
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Time skew could cause legitimate requests to be rejected or expired requests to be accepted
